design.description: One borrowed row-pair/tile reader serves opaque and weighted byte/word execution. Normalize only two16-pixel tiles, share the existing exact SIMD luma kernel and retain exact weighted/opaque/scalar chroma. An8-byte detached value prepares four alpha samples and the truncated reciprocal once per2x2 cell, including the scalar fallback. No duplicate scheduler, new heap buffer, full-frame intermediate, owner, pool or cache.
design.pixelPolicy: Preserve ushort normalization, gamma, EXACT reciprocal truncation, unweighted all-zero/all-opaque cells, hidden RGB, edge replication, padding and subsequent transparent cleanup. No new tolerance.

pairedComparison.boundary: Fixed bounded adjacent original/candidate pairs, alternating order, complete public RGBA8/RGBA16 WebP encodes per subject, including required per-operation depth normalization, fixed operation count recorded per pair, all pairs retained without filtering. Each isolated immutable assembly owns an identical resident source. Setup/JIT/validation excluded; fresh MemoryStream construction/growth, complete encode, independent output and disposal included. Scoped managed-build comparison resolves native-bracket clock uncertainty, not new FFmpeg costs or parity proof.
